question: Given among the options, _______ is a state/UT with highest literacy rate(census 2011).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** is the Union Territory with the highest literacy rate as per Census 2011.
 
• The literacy rate in **Lakshadweep** is approximately 92.28%, which is higher than most states and Union Territories in India.
 
• The high literacy rate in **Lakshadweep** can be attributed to the effective implementation of educational policies and programs.
 
• Other states with high literacy rates include **Kerala** and **Mizoram**, but among the given options, Lakshadweep ranks the highest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and is a comprehensive source of demographic data.
 
• The **2011 Census** was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872 and the 7th after independence.
 
• It provides detailed information on various parameters including population, literacy rate, sex ratio, and more.
 
• The **literacy rate** is calculated as the percentage of literate persons aged seven and above.
 
• Effective educational policies and increased awareness about the importance of education have contributed to rising literacy rates across India.
 
• Efforts to enhance literacy include initiatives such as the **Midday Meal Scheme**, **Right to Education Act**, and various state-specific programs.
